sources.population: Adults 18–65, symptoms ≥3 months, ultrasound tendinopathy; full-thickness tear, elevation <90°, resting pain >40/100 excluded.
sources.comparator: Same exercise program, progressive high-load versus low-load cuff exercises.
sources.coInterventions: Both groups scapular and mobility exercises/education; some received corticosteroid before randomization.
sources.outcomes: DASH group difference −1.37 (95% CI −6.72 to 3.99); no high-load superiority.
sources.uncertainty: No untreated group; selected population; corticosteroid interaction exploratory.
sources.harms: Three worsening-symptom referrals for surgery; no significant group difference in increased-pain/strength-loss episodes.
sources.limitations: Eligibility exclusions are not contraindications; regimen is study extraction, not app prescription.

protocol.execution: Standing dumbbell scaption at 45° between flexion/abduction to horizontal, side-lying dumbbell ER with elbow by side; supine dumbbell scapular protraction; standing straight-arm elastic-band extension.
protocol.dose: Cuff low-load: 3 sets 20–25RM; high-load: 4 sets progressing 15RM to 6RM. Scapular exercises 3 sets of 20.
protocol.progression: Cuff high-load 15RM week 1 to 6RM weeks 9–12; low-load maintained 20–25RM. Range/load adjusted if symptoms.
protocol.stoppingRules: Protocol: pain ≤5/10, returns toward baseline within 30 min, no worsening following days; adjust ROM/load, isometric option if necessary; contact therapist if adjustment fails. Numeric rules are protocol-specific, not damage thresholds.

sources.population: Episode ≤6 months; significant trauma, surgery candidates, instability/frozen shoulder excluded.
sources.comparator: Up to six progressive-exercise sessions versus one advice session; factorial injection/no injection.
